rows.title: Rodenstock Rodagon 1:2.8 f=50mm Enlarging Lens
rows.body:
Rodenstock Rodagon 1:2.8 f=50mm Enlarging Lens

High-quality vintage Rodenstock Rodagon 50mm f/2.8 enlarging lens, designed for producing sharp 35mm black-and-white or color darkroom enlargements. This respected six-element German optical lens is known for strong contrast, good edge-to-edge detail, and dependable all-metal construction.

Features an M39 enlarger mount, 40.5mm filter thread, and adjustable aperture from f/2.8 to f/16. The Rodagon is optimized for close-range enlargement work—approximately 2× to 15× magnification—and is also popular for macro photography when used with bellows, helicoids, or other appropriate adapters.

Please note: This is an enlarging lens, not a standard camera lens. It has no built-in focusing mechanism and requires the proper adapter and focusing setup for camera use. Please examine all photos for the exact cosmetic condition, glass condition, included accessories, and compatibility before purchase.
